checks: Creating a profile preserves and uploads existing guest work
A fresh phone signs in case-insensitively; the PIN is absent from browser storage and URLs, and JavaScript cannot read the session cookie
A real past-tense round transfers its submitted first attempt, review record, chosen settings and unfinished typed answer to the phone
Concurrent offline and phone edits require an explicit choice; both recovery downloads are intact and the chosen version reaches the other device
Expired sign-in retains unsynced work and uploads it after reauthentication
Sign-out clears only this device; signing back in restores saved work and the other device remains signed in
Refresh resumes the profile without asking for the PIN; no uncaught browser errors
local.limitations: Chromium synthetic journeys, not physical-device or penetration testing.
